findings.issue: Critical prompt files (final_reconciliation_repo_audit_prompt.md, final_reconciliation_principal_audit_prompt.md, final_full_repo_deep_dive_quality_confirmation_prompt.md) are stubs containing 'Replace this placeholder' - not usable for execution
findings.impact: Core reconciliation prompts cannot be executed as-is. The testrun_001/prompts/ directory contains placeholders instead of executable prompts.
findings.fix: Populate stub prompt files with the full content from final_reconciliation_prompt_pack/FULL_PROMPT_PACK.md phases

findings.issue: Dev compose web service depends_on api: condition: service_healthy, but the dev API service has no healthcheck defined (prod compose has it)
findings.impact: `docker compose up` will wait indefinitely for the API healthcheck to pass. Dev environment fails to start on fresh deployments.
findings.fix: Add healthcheck block to dev API service matching the prod pattern, or remove the condition from depends_on

findings.issue: All 4 worker processors (webhook-delivery, notification, search-indexer, cleanup) are TODO stubs that return mock responses - no actual work is performed
findings.impact: The worker service runs but does nothing. Webhook delivery, notification processing, search indexing, and cleanup are no-ops. The entire worker infrastructure is cosmetic.
findings.fix: Implement actual business logic in each processor, or remove the worker if processing happens in-process in the API

findings.issue: Dev Dockerfiles use node:20-alpine while production Dockerfiles use node:22-alpine - version mismatch between environments
findings.impact: Local dev runs on Node 20, production runs on Node 22. Behavior differences between versions may cause production-only bugs.
findings.fix: Align dev Dockerfiles to use node:22-alpine to match production

findings.issue: Terraform variable default droplet_size is s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb but tfvars uses s-2vcpu-2gb - default has not been updated after OOM upgrade documented in AGENTS.md
findings.impact: New deployments using defaults will provision undersized droplets that will OOM.
findings.fix: Update default droplet_size to s-2vcpu-2gb in variables.tf

findings.issue: Feature-flags module is the only one with logic in lib/ instead of modules/ with service.ts - every other module has co-located routes.ts + service.ts
findings.impact: Structural inconsistency makes the codebase harder to navigate. Move feature-flags logic from lib/ to modules/feature-flags/service.ts
findings.fix: Move feature-flags business logic to modules/feature-flags/service.ts

findings.issue: Duplicate migration files: 20260625000007_add_missing_indexes.sql and 20260627000001_add_missing_indexes.sql define overlapping indexes. Two data retention migrations exist (20260625000015, 20260627000002)
findings.impact: Unclear which migration is canonical. Risk of running superseded migrations on new databases.
findings.fix: Remove superseded migration files after verifying no production migration chain depends on them

findings.issue: push-subscription-service.ts is the only service file that doesn't follow service.ts naming convention
findings.impact: Inconsistent filename pattern. File should be service.ts or live in a subdirectory.
findings.fix: Rename to service.ts or extract to subdirectory

findings.issue: Cloud-init UFW firewall only opens ports 22, 80, 443 but DigitalOcean firewall allows LiveKit ports (7882-7892 UDP, 3478 UDP, 5349 TCP)
findings.impact: LiveKit TURN/WebRTC ports blocked by UFW despite DO firewall allowing them. Media/voice calls will fail.
findings.fix: Add UFW rules for LiveKit ports to cloud-init template

findings.issue: 8 docs files still reference the removed infra/docker/traefik/ directory
findings.impact: Stale documentation references that confuse readers about the current architecture.
findings.fix: Update or remove Traefik references from all 8 docs files

findings.issue: AGENTS.md claims setup-dev.sh uses wrong migration paths (packages/db/sql/) and that hardening.yml triggers on push/pull_request - both claims are incorrect/stale
findings.impact: Incorrect documentation misleads developers about the actual codebase state.
findings.fix: Update AGENTS.md to reflect current state: correct migration paths and actual hardening.yml triggers
